maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from recruiter job-posting and resume-database subscriptions on Dice and ClearanceJobs, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by private employers and recruiters, including defense contractors like Lockheed Martin, buying subscriptions on Dice and ClearanceJobs.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling Dice and ClearanceJobs subscriptions; M&A is mentioned but acquisitions are occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Recruiting job boards and subscriptions are easily switched; employers can use other job boards or LinkedIn with little disruption.

notes: Dice is the larger business; ClearanceJobs is the other part.
